ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached image shows a square rotated into the shape of a rhombus, with a total of 8 circles on the boundary. The four blue circles are exactly at the four vertex positions of the square: top, bottom, left, and right. There are 3 circles on each side: the two endpoints are blue circles, and there is 1 white circle in the middle. Therefore, the four white circles are respectively located in the middle of the four sides. Reasoning: Let the sum of the numbers in the four blue vertex circles be C, and the sum of the numbers in the four white middle circles be W. The problem says Rita uses 1 to 8 to number these circles, so the total sum of the numbers in all the circles is 1+2+3+4+5+6+7+8=36, that is, C+W=36. Also because the sum of the three numbers on each side is 13, the total sum of the four sides is 4×13=52. When adding the sums of the four sides, each blue vertex circle belongs to two sides, so each blue circle is counted twice; each white middle circle is only on one side, so each white circle is counted once. Therefore there is 2C+W=52. Subtract C+W=36 from 2C+W=52 to get C=16. So the sum of the numbers on the four colored circles is 16.

method.method_draft: Read the image as a rotated square with 8 circles around its boundary: the four colored circles are exactly the four vertices, and each side contains three circles: colored endpoint, uncolored middle circle, colored endpoint. From the text, the numbers 1 through 8 are used once, and each side has sum 13. Let C be the sum of the four colored corner numbers and W be the sum of the four uncolored middle numbers. Adding the four side-sum equations gives 4·13 = 52. In this total, every colored corner is counted twice because it belongs to two sides, while every uncolored middle circle is counted once. Therefore 2C + W = 52. Also C + W = 1+2+...+8 = 36. Subtract the total-number equation from the side-count equation to get C = 16.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram clockwise as four colored corner circles a, b, c, d, with four uncolored side-middle circles e, f, g, h between adjacent colored corners. The text gives four equations from the four sides: a+e+b=13, b+f+c=13, c+g+d=13, and d+h+a=13. Rearrange each equation to express an adjacent colored-pair sum: a+b=13-e, b+c=13-f, c+d=13-g, and d+a=13-h. Add these four equations. The left side becomes 2(a+b+c+d), since each colored corner appears in two adjacent pairs. The right side is 52-(e+f+g+h). Since all numbers 1 through 8 are used, e+f+g+h = 36-(a+b+c+d). Substitute and solve for the colored sum a+b+c+d, giving 16.

推理：按顺时针把四个蓝色顶点圆圈中的数记为 a、b、c、d，把相邻蓝色圆圈之间的四个白色中点圆圈中的数记为 e、f、g、h。题目说每条边上三个数的和都是 13，因此有：a+e+b=13，b+f+c=13，c+g+d=13，d+h+a=13。改写为相邻蓝色数之和：a+b=13-e，b+c=13-f，c+d=13-g，d+a=13-h。四式相加，左边为 2(a+b+c+d)，右边为 52-(e+f+g+h)。因为 1 到 8 全部使用一次，总和是 36，所以 e+f+g+h=36-(a+b+c+d)。设蓝色圆圈数之和 S=a+b+c+d，则 2S=52-(36-S)=16+S，所以 S=16。
